starship_full_reuse.what: Connectivity capex falls to ~12% of revenue (base 20%) and ~$10bn of new heavy-lift/HLS/defence revenue at 40% EBIT by 2031

direct_to_cell_at_scale.what: 150m paying D2C users at ~$8/month, 50% EBIT after D2C satellite capex (spectrum cost already in the base)

xai_frontier_lab_win.what: Grok/xAI becomes a top-two frontier lab: SI revenue ~$250bn at 35% EBIT in 2031 (base SI ~$146bn at 12%)

mars.what: no cash value inside the horizon; a 1m-person colony is the vesting condition of 1,000m Musk restricted shares

ai_in_space.what: orbital data centres: no filed milestone; 100 TW in space vests 302m Musk shares; not sizeable

tesla_merger_note: At the market ratio the deal moves value between holders only as far as the two prices are wrong relative to value. On our numbers both trade far above value (SPCX ~5x, TSLA ~12x on a draft base), so an SPCX holder swapping into a combined company at the market ratio gives up intrinsic value; a premium for SPCX holders reduces that. Musk restricted shares (1,302m) and Tesla CEO awards would need terms.
